name: agi-system
description: AGI-OS / Agent OS - Production-grade autonomous agent operating system with 12-layer GitHub engineering + 2026 Agent-Native (Rulesets, Attestations, SBOM, Evaluations)

scripts.dev: turbo run dev --parallel || npm run dev --workspaces --if-present --parallel
scripts.eval:all: npm run eval:capabilities && npm run eval:safety && npm run eval:long-horizon && npm run eval:tool-use
scripts.benchmark:all: node benchmarks/latency/run.js --output certification/benchmarks/latency.json && node benchmarks/memory/run.js --output certification/benchmarks/memory.json && node benchmarks/planning/run.js --output certification/benchmarks/planning.json && node benchmarks/tool-use/run.js --output certification/benchmarks/tool-use.json && node benchmarks/long-horizon/run.js --output certification/benchmarks/long-horizon.json && node scripts/benchmark/aggregate.js
scripts.sbom: echo 'SBOM via anchore/sbom-action in CI, local: npx @anchore/sbom-action || syft packages dir'
scripts.check:2026: npm run verify:policy && npm run verify:safety && npm run verify:attestation && npm run benchmark:all
